commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+4' A corner kick by Mallorca is thwarted by the well prepared Orjan Nyland (Sevilla).
90+1' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Mallorca comes to nothing.
90+1' Substitution. Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Chidera Ejuke walks off.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
89' That was really pointless. Saul Niguez (Sevilla) was being offensive and couldn't control himself. He gave Alejandro Ruiz no choice but to send him off.
88' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
86' Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) commits a rough foul. Alejandro Ruiz stops the game and makes a call.
86' Martin Valjent (Mallorca) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle for a foul.
85' Samu Costa (Mallorca) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
83' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Mallorca.
83' Takuma Asano (Mallorca) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Now Mallorca have a corner.
82' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to make a change. Abdon Prats (Mallorca) replaces Vedat Muriqi.
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Sergi Darder departs the field of play to be replaced by Marc Domenech (Mallorca).
81' The corner is swung in but Sevilla can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
81' Jesus Navas (Sevilla) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.

75' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) whips the ball in from the free kick, but it goes well out of play.
74' The players claim that Jesus Navas (Sevilla) handled the ball and it seems they are right. Mallorca have a free kick.
73' Substitution. Manu Morlanes did his best and is replaced by Omar Mascarell (Mallorca).
72' Mallorca control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
70' Takuma Asano (Mallorca) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but he misses the left post by a whisker. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla will have a goal kick.
70' Problems for Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta as Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Marcao replaces him.

65' Substitution. Cyle Larin makes way for Takuma Asano (Mallorca).
65' The referee signals a substitution. Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) is brought on as a substitute for Antonio Sanchez.
65' Samu Costa (Mallorca) misses a great chance after he found some space in the box! His glancing header goes over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla will have a goal kick.
64' Mallorca force a corner. They send men into the box.
64' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Orjan Nyland pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
63' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta has decided to substitute Albert Sambi Lokonga and he is replaced by Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla).
62' It will be a substitution. Isaac Romero (Sevilla) is ready to enter the pitch as Kelechi Iheanacho walks off.
61' Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) takes the corner with a short pass.
60' Saul Niguez (Sevilla) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play. Sevilla are awarded a corner kick.
57' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) latches on to a superb cross into the box and plants a header well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sevilla.
56' Loic Bade (Sevilla) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Alejandro Ruiz has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.

55' Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Orjan Nyland makes a comfortable save to stop the effort from flying into the middle of the goal.

53' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
52' Dangerous play by Sergi Darder (Mallorca). Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle for a foul.
51' Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
51' Saul Niguez (Sevilla) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Sevilla.
50' Sevilla can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
50' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball goes out for a corner. Sevilla can continue in their attacking effort.
49' Sevilla work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
49' Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Sevilla earn a corner.

45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
45' Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Sevilla have been awarded a corner kick.
44' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
40' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle for a foul.

39' Excellent touch by Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box but miskicks and the ball goes well wide of the right post. Poor effort. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
36' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
33' Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) hits a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a comfortable save for Leo Roman as it's directed low at the middle of the goal.
33' Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

33' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla have been awarded a corner kick.
31' Mallorca are ruled offside.
29' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
28' Sevilla quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
27' Saul Niguez (Sevilla) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the left side of the goal. However, Leo Roman anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
26' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
24' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
22' Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle for a foul after Djibril Sow (Sevilla) hacks down one of his opponents.
21' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Sevilla is cautioned for aggressive play.
20' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) gets on the end of a defence splitting pass inside the box and immediately directs a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Leo Roman makes a great save.
19' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
18' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) takes the free kick which is dealt with by the opposition defence.
17' Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) commits a rough challenge and Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle for an infringement.
16' The ball is cleared after Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

14' Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) takes a shot after receiving a good pass, but his effort from the edge of the box goes just over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla will have a goal kick.
13' A player from Sevilla commits a rough challenge. Alejandro Ruiz blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
11' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the corner, but his fine header towards the right post is brilliantly saved by the diving goalkeeper.
11' Good work from Mallorca as they win a corner.
11' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) rises high to connect with a lofted pass inside the box, but one of his opponents is in the right place at the right time to thwart him.
10' Mallorca enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
7' Saul Niguez (Sevilla) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Alejandro Ruiz no option but to blow his whistle.
6' Alejandro Ruiz couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) and blew his whistle.
5' Handball by Cyle Larin (Mallorca).
3' Samu Costa (Mallorca) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sevilla.
